external_preregistration_requirements.proof: public third-party server-stamped event before cutoff + SHA256 equality of protocol and forecast contents

monetary_claims: BLOCKED; no SSQ06, no expected winning or profitable betting claim
official_result_verification: source evidence must be checked independently before outcome entered into qualified prospective score
pre_existing_hypothesis_testing_bias: V0.5 parameters were designed using past outcomes; precommit only applies to future unobserved outcomes

primary_null: per drawing conditionally uniform six unordered reds from 33, one blue from 16; drawings independent given past

primary_sequential_test.name: FAIR_NULL_E_PROCESS
